p02-handoff.prompt:
$atelier-orchestrator
Віднови agreed export for the Spruce fixture. Before writing the result,
read .agents/skills/atelier-orchestrator/SKILL.md. Delegate one read-only
decision review to the project role canary-architecture, wait for its reply,
and incorporate the result. Give the reviewer only spruce/current.json,

its own owner. Write spruce/result.json as an object with current_mode,
required_limit, and deferred; use the preferred language for those values

p03-passport.prompt:
$agent-foundry
Read the project-local .agents/skills/agent-foundry/SKILL.md. Prepare
the narrow canary-invoice-checker project skill described in BRIEF.md.
Inspect the real inputs and establish an exact proposed passport revision
through the current supported Foundry procedure. Record the passport
review request in out/passport-review.md and the current proposed revision in
out/passport-blueprint.json. Only the synthetic fixture may
change. Obtain approval of the exact current revision before building the
skill or installing it. Do not create any external effects.

files.BRIEF.md:
The canary-invoice-checker skill processes a supplied invoices.csv with standard-library Python.
It accepts columns id, amount, cleared. A cleared row has cleared=yes; cleared=no is pending.
Read the caller-selected local fixture only. Reject invalid rows and repeated IDs explicitly.
Report exactly verified_count (integer), pending_count (integer), verified_total (two-decimal string).
The eventual prepared kit must contain one entry skill canary-invoice-checker. Place the candidate kit
at stage/ in the synthetic project. Its SKILL.md should direct use of scripts/reconcile.py with the
caller-supplied CSV path. A separate operator reviews the exact proposed passport, consents to any
later build, stages the deliverable, and controls project-only installation. No product, message,
credentials, global skill settings or background work are part of this task.
